NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PawPi uses your location to find nearby pet-friendly places, vets, walkers and meetups, to set a location on social walks, transport and events, and to share your live location while you drive a pet-taxi trip.
NSCameraUsageDescription: PawPi uses the camera so you can take photos of your pet for their profile, daily moments, health checks and vet records.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PawPi accesses your photo library so you can choose photos and documents for your pet's profile, posts, health records and chats.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: PawPi saves photos you create in the app, such as your pet's shareable daily-moment frame, to your photo library.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PawPi uses the microphone for audio in vet telehealth video consultations.
NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: PawPi adds your pet's appointments, bookings and reminders to your calendar so you don't miss them.
NSCalendarsUsageDescription: PawPi adds your pet's appointments, bookings and reminders to your calendar so you don't miss them.
